q: How does a PET recycler count the hot wash line's steam and power?
title: PET recyclers: hot wash steam and power
short: Count the boiler fuel that makes the wash steam as Scope 1 and the line's grid power as Scope 2, then divide both by kg of flake washed. Caustic soda and detergents are purchased goods in Scope 3.
audience: PET bottle recyclers running hot wash lines for flake

p: Boiler fuel per month x its factor (PNG 2.05 kg CO2 per scm, coal or diesel by IPCC default).
Divide the total by kg of clean flake.
If the boiler also serves other lines, split steam by a meter or by hours, and record the split.

example.title: Worked example: one day (illustrative quantities)
lines: Line power: 5,200 kWh x 0.710 = 3,692 kg CO2
Power per kg: 3,692 / 8,000 = 0.462 kg CO2, before boiler fuel

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
